newSignedForm.label: New Signed Form
newSignedForm.template: Please submit a newly signed {formName} with updated signatures and dates as, {reason}

correctedForm.label: Corrected Form - Initials Required
correctedForm.template: Please resubmit the {formName} reflecting {correctionReason}. Please have the {persom} initial and date by the correction(s).

unauthorizedDigitalSignature.label: Unauthorized Digital Signature

missingForm.label: Missing Form
missingForm.template: Please submit the {formName} as it was not included with the application and is required.

questionMissing.label: Question Not Answered
questionMissing.template: Please provide a response to question {questionNumber} as it was unanswered.

questionConflict.label: Conflicting Answers
questionConflict.template: Please clarify the response to questions {questionOne} and {questionTwo}, as the answers conflict.

ownerNameCorrection.label: Owner Name Correction
ownerNameCorrection.template: The owner's name reflected on all forms in the application should read {value}.

ownerAddressCorrection.label: Owner Address Correction
ownerAddressCorrection.template: The owner's address reflected on all forms in the application should read {value}.

insuredNameCorrection.label: Insured Name Correction
insuredNameCorrection.template: The insured's name reflected on all forms in the application should read {value}.

insuredAddressCorrection.label: Insured Address Correction
insuredAddressCorrection.template: The insured's address reflected on all forms in the application should read {value}.

signature.label: Signature
signature.template: The signature of {signer} on the {form} is {value}.

signedDate.label: Signed Date
signedDate.template: The {form} was signed by the {party} on {date}.

signedLocation.label: Signed Location
signedLocation.template: The {form} was signed by the {party} in {location}.

ownerBeneficiaryMatchPolicy.label: Owner And Beneficiary Match Policy
ownerBeneficiaryMatchPolicy.template: Beneficiary and Owner to be the same as specified on the policy specification pages of the policy.

ownerMatchPolicy.label: Owner Match Policy
ownerMatchPolicy.template: Owner to be the same as specified on the policy specification pages of the policy.

beneficiaryMatchPolicy.label: Beneficiary Match Policy
beneficiaryMatchPolicy.template: Beneficiary to be the same as specified on the policy specification pages of the policy.

custodianDesignation.label: Custodian Designation
custodianDesignation.template: Question {question} of the Part 1 is during the minority of the named {childType}, {custodian} shall be custodian for said {childType} under the {state} Uniform Transfers/Gifts to Minors Act.

deleteAdditionalInsured.label: Delete Additional Insured
deleteAdditionalInsured.template: The information listed for Insured {insuredNumber} in the Part 1 application is hereby deleted and not applicable. All references to Insured {oldInsured} in the Part 1 application now pertains to Insured {newInsured}. There is only 1 Insured, {insuredName}.

deleteSignature.label: Delete Signature
deleteSignature.template: The signature of {signer} on the {form} is incorrect and hereby deleted.

illustrationConforms.label: Illustration Conforms
illustrationConforms.template: Question N1 of Part 1 is, The sales illustration used for the proposed insured conforms to the policy as applied for.

illustrationNoIllustration.label: No Illustration Used
illustrationNoIllustration.template: Question N1 of Part 1 is, No sales illustration was used in the sale of the policy.

illustrationDoesNotConform.label: Illustration Does Not Conform
illustrationDoesNotConform.template: Question N1 of Part 1 is, The sales illustration used for the proposed insured does not conform to the policy as applied for.
